event.distribution_pattern: National US distribution only: OR, NY, KS, PA, CA, TX, NH, WA.

products.product_description: Two Moms in the Raw, Gluten-Free Pesto Sea Cracker enclosed in brown semi-synthetic packaging with a transparent section displaying the contents. Labeling on the product is green, white, and blue with blue, green, and red print writing.
products.reason_for_recall: Two Moms in the Raw is issuing a voluntary recall for Pesto Sea Cracker, 4 oz, because they were notified by their raw material supplier that the pine nuts used in the product may contain peanuts.
